caption:
Both are reasonable, and your college's rules decide a lot of it. At many colleges, accepting a PPO takes you out of placements, so check your placement cell's policy first.

A is a sure offer from a team that has already seen your work. You skip months of tests and interviews and can spend final year learning what that team uses.

B can mean a higher package or a role you want more. It also means trading a sure offer for a chance.

Things to weigh: how much you learned in the internship, the people on the team, and how many companies actually visit your campus.

If you faced this, which way did you go?
